request.content:
You are tuning a "projector" that turns a short camera video into plain text (character art). A vision-language model then tries to reconstruct the scene (objects, positions, motion directions) from the text alone; its agreement with a reading of the real video is "vlm" fidelity (0..1). "jepa" (0..1) measures how well the text predicts where the next frame will change. Fewer characters and less compute (ms) are better. The utility is U = vlm + 0.25*jepa - 0.05*chars/1000 - 0.002*ms.

Available projectors and their typed parameters:
mirror: brightness-only density ramp; the lake-test baseline
  cols: int [16, 160] (default 64)
  ramp: enum standard|short|long|blocks (default "standard")
  gamma: float [0.3, 3] (default 1)
  invert: bool (default false)
  frames: int [1, 4] (default 1)

syzygy: the byte-exact fused kernel (docs/poc/syzygy.js) as a projector: edge glyphs, braille or tone
  cols: int [16, 160] (default 64)
  field: enum glyph|braille|tone (default "glyph")
  braille_thresh: int [0, 255] (default 100)
  edge_thresh2: int [0, 400000] (default 4000)
  orient: enum gradient|tangent (default "gradient")
  frames: int [1, 4] (default 1)

motion: temporal-median background + tracked foreground blobs; arrows show what moved and which way
  cols: int [16, 160] (default 64)
  history: int [3, 16] (default 12)
  window: int [2, 8] (default 4)
  thresh: float [4, 120] (default 24)
  min_blob: int [1, 20] (default 2)
  min_speed: float [0.05, 3] (default 0.3)
  bg: enum tone|fused|edges|braille|dim|blank (default "tone")
  braille_thresh: int [0, 255] (default 100)
  ramp: enum standard|short|blocks (default "standard")
  mark: enum fill|edge|head (default "edge")
  arrows: enum ascii|unicode (default "ascii")
  trail: int [0, 7] (default 3)
  legend: bool (default false)
